skill.name: docs
skill.description: Research official documentation, find canonical examples, and explain library APIs with concise, version-aware guidance.
skill.summary: Research official documentation and explain APIs with clear references and examples.
skill.author: 0xSero

security_audit.summary: The reviewed skill is a prompt-only documentation helper with no executable files or static security findings. SKILL.md directs the assistant to prefer official documentation, explain APIs clearly, and provide concise references. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or business-logic abuse was found.

content.value_statement: Developers often lose time finding reliable API details and current examples. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to prioritize official documentation and produce concise explanations.
actual_capabilities: Guides documentation research toward official sources and canonical examples.
Explains APIs and library behavior with direct, low-jargon summaries.
Highlights version-specific details and caveats when they are known.
Produces short examples or reference notes that are easy to follow.
Supports web-backed research when the host assistant provides web access.
limitations: It does not include executable scripts, custom tools, or automation code.
It depends on the host assistant and available web access for current documentation.
It cannot guarantee that third-party documentation is complete or correct.
It is configured for research guidance, not direct code editing.

use_cases.title: Understand an unfamiliar API
use_cases.description: Get a concise explanation of methods, parameters, return values, and common usage from official documentation.

use_cases.title: Prepare implementation guidance
use_cases.description: Collect reliable references and practical notes before writing integration tasks or internal documentation.

use_cases.title: Check version-specific behavior
use_cases.description: Ask for known differences, caveats, and migration notes before adopting a library feature.

prompt_templates.title: Find Official Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for a library or framework feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official documentation for [library or framework] about [feature]. Summarize the key points and include the most useful reference links.

prompt_templates.title: Explain an API
prompt_templates.scenario: Understand how a specific API works before using it.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the [API name] API in [library]. Cover its purpose, required inputs, return behavior, common options, and important caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Version Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Research how [feature] changed between [version A] and [version B]. Focus on official release notes, migration guidance, and breaking changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create Integration Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research for planning an implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create implementation notes for using [technology] in [project context]. Include official references, assumptions, risks, and questions to verify before development.

output_examples.input: Explain how React effect cleanup works using official documentation.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes when cleanup runs, why it prevents stale subscriptions, and where the official React documentation explains the behavior.

output_examples.input: Find the official guidance for FastAPI dependency injection.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the relevant FastAPI documentation, explains dependency resolution in plain language, and lists practical caveats for shared dependencies.

output_examples.input: Compare caching behavior in two Next.js versions.
output_examples.output: The response highlights documented behavior changes, migration concerns, and links to official release notes or framework documentation.

best_practices: Ask for official sources first, then request examples or summaries.
Include library names, versions, and runtime context in the prompt.
Ask the assistant to separate confirmed facts from assumptions.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on unsourced answers for version-sensitive API behavior.
Do not ask for broad research without naming the library or feature.
Do not treat generated examples as authoritative without checking references.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant to research documentation, find examples, explain APIs, and highlight version caveats.

faq.question: Does it run code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable scripts or automation files.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it browse the web?
faq.answer: The skill declares web support, but actual browsing depends on the host assistant configuration.

faq.question: Is it useful for outdated documentation?
faq.answer: Yes, when web or reference access is available. Ask for version numbers and release notes for better results.

faq.question: Can it edit project files?
faq.answer: No. Its configuration disables write and edit tool permissions.
